verdict.rationale: Steel documents an official CLI that runs full browser workflows end-to-end from the terminal: start a session, navigate, click/fill/type, extract, and stop (steel-docs-8, steel-probe-3). It is explicitly positioned for AI-native use, installed alongside the steel-browser skill so agents can drive a browser (steel-docs-12), and also offers scaffolding commands like `steel forge` (steel-docs-45). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in use.
